title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-02-001
doc_notes: This document is a collection of news clippings and FAA reports regarding the JAL Flight 1628 UFO incident in Alaska, including investigative follow-ups and skeptical analysis.

incidents.summary: Japan Air Lines Flight 1628 crew reported being followed by two small lights and a massive walnut-shaped object over Alaska.
incidents.explanation: FAA concluded radar blips were split-image echoes of the aircraft; skeptics suggested Jupiter and Mars.
incidents.quote: It was like a dream. Unbelievable.
incidents.size: twice the size of an aircraft carrier

incidents.summary: Capt. Terauchi reported a second sighting of irregular lights while flying cargo over Alaska.
incidents.explanation: FAA officials speculated it was a bounce light effect from village lights reflected off ice crystals.
incidents.quote: Irregular lights, looks like a space ship.

incidents.summary: Alaska Airlines pilots reported a target on weather radar near McGrath.
